plugins.name: forge-beta
plugins.description: A development process for coding agents: brainstorm → spec → plan → TDD execution with approval gates, tiered workers, and project memory. Claude Code + Codex CLI. Pre-release (0.12.3-beta): a spec is now validated against the codebase by a cold reviewer before planning begins — a mechanical reference table the reviewer owes a disposition on, a document-shaped verdict whose dependency and section claims are verified rather than trusted, and design-anti-patterns.md as the single tuning surface for what the review hunts.
